{{Quote|Used by New Republic troops in the battle of Glom Tho, the decisive encounter of the Hevvrol Sector Campaign. Achieved a record satisfaction rating of 97.3 percents!|An advertisement for the [[Sure-Sight|NeuroSaav Sure-Sight]]|<ref name="RPG2" />}}
The '''Hevvrol Sector Campaign''' was a series of battles between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Battles included an [[Battle of Bannistar Station|assault]] on [[Bannistar Station]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The [[Battle of Glom Tho|Battle]] of [[Glom Tho]] was a decisive New Republic victory.<ref name="RPG2" />
